title: Python
tagline: From first print() to web scraping, Flask, Django and FastAPI
description: A complete Python revision track that starts with syntax, data structures and functions, moves through OOP, the standard library and advanced topics like async and testing, and then covers real-world work: web scraping (Requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy), web frameworks (Flask, Django, FastAPI) and data/automation scripts.
